changeSet.author: racine
changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_template SET text = REPLACE(text, '${firstname}', '${name}') WHERE name LIKE 'SELF_SERVICE_%_SMS' AND text LIKE '%${firstname}%'

changeSet.author: racine
changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_template SET text = CONCAT('Hola ${name}, ', LOWER(SUBSTRING(text, 1, 1)), SUBSTRING(text, 2)) WHERE name IN ('SELF_SERVICE_TRANSFER_OTP_SMS', 'SELF_SERVICE_SINPE_ENROLLMENT_OTP_SMS', 'SELF_SERVICE_SINPE_ENROLLMENT_SUCCESS_SMS', 'SELF_SERVICE_SINPE_SUBSCRIPTION_CREATED_SMS', 'SELF_SERVICE_SINPE_SUBSCRIPTION_UPDATED_SMS', 'SELF_SERVICE_SINPE_SUBSCRIPTION_DELETED_SMS') AND text NOT LIKE '%${name}%'

column.name: text
column.value: Hi ${name}, to create your user use Request ID ${requestId} and code ${authCode}.

update.where: name = 'SELF_SERVICE_ENROLLMENT_TOKEN_SMS' AND text = 'Hello ${name}, to create a user use Request ID: ${requestId} and Authorization Code: ${authCode}. Regards, The Institution Team'

column.name: text
column.value: Hi ${name}, transfer of ${transactionAmount} from ${fromAccountNumber} to ${toAccountNumber} was successful. #${transferId}

update.where: name = 'SELF_SERVICE_TRANSFER_SUCCESS_SMS' AND text = 'Hi ${name}, your transfer of ${transactionAmount} from ${fromAccountNumber} to ${toAccountNumber} on ${transactionDate} was successful. Ref: ${transferId}. Desc: ${transferDescription}.'
name = 'SELF_SERVICE_ACCESS_CHANGED_SMS' AND text = 'Hi ${name}, ${accessChange} Reason: ${reason}. For help, ${supportContact}.'

column.name: text
column.value: Hola ${name}, tu código para restablecer la contraseña es ${authCode}. Expira en ${expirationMinutes} min. Si no lo pediste, ignóralo.

update.where: name = 'SELF_SERVICE_PASSWORD_RESET_REQUESTED_SMS' AND text = 'Hola ${name}, tu código para restablecer la contraseña de ${username} es: ${authCode}. Expira en ${expirationMinutes} min. Si no lo solicitaste, ignora este mensaje.'

column.name: text
column.value: Hola ${name}, tu contraseña fue restablecida. Si no fuiste tú, contacta a soporte.

update.where: name = 'SELF_SERVICE_PASSWORD_RENEWED_SMS' AND text = 'Hola ${name}, la contraseña de tu cuenta ${username} ha sido restablecida exitosamente. Si no fuiste tú, contacta inmediatamente a soporte.'

column.name: text
column.value: Hola ${name}, su número ${mobileNumber} fue verificado para SINPE Móvil. Ya puede transferir.

update.where: name = 'SELF_SERVICE_SINPE_ENROLLMENT_SUCCESS_SMS' AND text = 'Hola ${name}, su número ${mobileNumber} ha sido verificado exitosamente para SINPE Móvil. Ya puede realizar transferencias.'

column.name: text
column.value: Hola ${name}, su suscripción SINPE Móvil para ${phoneNumber} fue creada. IBAN: ${iban}.

update.where: name = 'SELF_SERVICE_SINPE_SUBSCRIPTION_CREATED_SMS' AND text = 'Hola ${name}, su suscripción SINPE Móvil para ${phoneNumber} ha sido creada exitosamente. IBAN: ${iban}.'
